title: Learning about Markets from Models: Evidence from an AI Hiring Platform
abstract: arXiv:2611.01226v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning models are increasingly used to not only inform, but make decisions. Sometimes platforms add value by pooling data across contexts to improve models' decision making---but when the optimal decision differs by context, pooling may not increase accuracy. We argue that a platform storing starkly distinct models across contexts nevertheless captures a model comparison externality. Together, these models reflect how decision makers respond differently to the same data in the current equilibrium. Policymakers can use this differentiation to prioritize interventions; firms can learn how they are already differentiated from competitors to focus future investments. Our evidence comes from an AI hiring platform used by large employers of low-skill workers. translated_title: 从模型中认识市场：来自一个AI招聘平台的证据
translated_abstract: 机器学习模型日益不仅用于为决策提供参考，还直接用于做出决策。有时平台通过跨情境汇总数据来提升模型的决策能力，从而创造价值——但当最优决策因情境而异时，数据汇总未必能提高准确性。我们认为，即使平台在不同情境中存储截然不同的模型，它仍然能捕捉到一种“模型比较外部性”。这些模型共同反映了在当前均衡状态下，决策者对相同数据作出不同反应的方式。政策制定者可以利用这种差异化来确定干预措施的优先次序；企业则可以了解自己与竞争对手之间已经存在的差异，从而聚焦未来的投资方向。我们的证据来自一个被大量雇用低技能劳动者的大型雇主所使用的AI招聘平台。该平台使用标准化的心理测评工具，为每个企业构建专属模型，以估计每份求职申请在该企业留任的可能性。每个企业的模型具有高度的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“模型比较外部性”概念，证明即使AI招聘平台为各企业存储截然不同的留任预测模型，这些模型之间的差异仍能揭示决策者对相同数据的不同反应方式，从而帮助政策制定者优先安排干预措施、帮助企业聚焦差异化投资。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of a "model comparison externality," showing that even when an AI hiring platform stores starkly distinct retention-prediction models across firms, the differences among these models reveal how decision makers respond differently to the same data—enabling policymakers to prioritize interventions and firms to target future investments.
